dlss_fg.video_settings.tooltip: Opens the Vulkan frame generation, upscaling, diagnostics and hardware ray-tracing settings.
dlss_fg.screen.settings.title: Frame Generation & Graphics
dlss_fg.screen.diagnostics.title: Frame Generation Diagnostics
dlss_fg.tooltip.section.frame_generation: Frame generation, upscaling, latency, motion-debug and compatibility settings for NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs.
dlss_fg.tooltip.section.graphics: Hybrid Vulkan ray-query settings for supported GPUs. Unsupported controls remain disabled and explain their requirements.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.nvidia: Native NVIDIA Streamline controls. DLSS features are enabled only when the driver and GPU report support.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.amd: AMD FidelityFX FSR 3.1 Vulkan controls. FSR 4 frame generation currently requires DirectX 12 and is not used here.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.intel: Intel upscaling and the cross-vendor FSR 3.1 Vulkan frame-generation fallback. Native XeSS-FG requires DirectX 12.
dlss_fg.tooltip.tab.ray_tracing: Hybrid block shadows and reflections using Vulkan acceleration structures and ray queries.
dlss_fg.tooltip.preset: Applies a coordinated group of frame-generation, latency and quality settings. Choose Custom to adjust controls manually.
dlss_fg.tooltip.run_diagnostics: Runs read-only capability and renderer-input checks. It does not change your settings. Results are shown on screen and written to latest.log.
dlss_fg.tooltip.frame_generation.conflic: Unavailable while %s frame generation is enabled. Disable the active frame-generation provider first; two interpolation providers cannot run together.
dlss_fg.tooltip.frame_generation.enable_: Enable this provider's frame generation before changing its frame multiplier.
dlss_fg.tooltip.performance_osd: Shows frame rate, pacing latency, active backend and captured-frame counters while playing.
dlss_fg.tooltip.motion_debug: Visualizes the motion-vector input used by frame generation. Arrows show direction, Heatmap shows magnitude and Raw Preview shows the sampled vector field. Visible only in a loaded world.
dlss_fg.tooltip.optiscaler: Enables the bundled OptiScaler bridge on AMD and Intel. A restart is required. An external copy in %s overrides the bundled runtime. NVIDIA always uses native Streamline.
dlss_fg.tooltip.auto_fallback: Planned feature: automatically selects the next compatible provider if the preferred backend fails. It is disabled because the switching logic is not implemented yet.
dlss_fg.tooltip.motion_blur: Planned feature: uses motion vectors for camera and object blur. It is disabled because the final render pass is not implemented yet.
dlss_fg.tooltip.drs: Planned feature: adjusts render resolution to maintain a target frame rate. It is disabled because automatic resolution control is not implemented yet.
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.frame_generation: Generates additional presented frames through NVIDIA Streamline. Requires a supported NVIDIA GPU, current driver, Reflex and valid color, depth and motion-vector inputs.
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.reflex: Reduces the render queue and coordinates CPU/GPU latency. Frame Generation automatically requires Reflex to remain enabled.
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.dlss_mode: Selects DLAA or a DLSS Super Resolution quality mode. Lower internal resolutions improve performance but can reduce fine detail.
dlss_fg.status.frame_generation.inactive: Inactive: no compatible GPU or native library | FG VRAM 0.00 MB
dlss_fg.backend_status.d3d12_required: this native FG route requires Direct3D 12
dlss_fg.backend_status.native_bridge_una: native bridge is unavailable or outdated
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.dlss_status: Read-only result of the NVIDIA Streamline hardware and driver capability query. Check latest.log for the exact rejection reason.
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.fg_multiplier: Selects the presented-frame multiplier reported by Streamline. 2x inserts one generated frame; higher Multi Frame Generation levels require supported hardware.
dlss_fg.tooltip.nvidia.reflex_pacing: Uses measured frame time to smooth presentation pacing alongside NVIDIA Reflex. This does not create additional frames by itself.
dlss_fg.tooltip.amd.frame_generation: Inserts one generated frame through the FidelityFX FSR 3.1 Vulkan provider. The control activates only after the provider accepts the required renderer inputs.
dlss_fg.tooltip.amd.upscaling: Selects the AMD Vulkan reconstruction path. Native AA keeps a 1:1 render resolution and applies reconstruction without spatial upscaling.
dlss_fg.tooltip.intel.frame_generation: Uses the cross-vendor FSR 3.1 Vulkan provider on Intel GPUs. It is intentionally not labeled XeSS-FG because native XeSS Frame Generation requires DirectX 12.
dlss_fg.tooltip.intel.upscaling: Selects the Intel-compatible reconstruction path through OptiScaler. The current renderer supplies a native-resolution input, so only Native AA is exposed.
dlss_fg.tooltip.fsr.fg_factor: FSR 3.1 inserts exactly one generated frame and therefore supports a 2x presented-frame factor only.
dlss_fg.tooltip.aa_sharpness: Controls reconstruction sharpening. High values produce a crisper image but can emphasize shimmering and halos.
dlss_fg.tooltip.ui_recomposition: Keeps HUD and menus out of generated world frames and composites the interface afterward to reduce ghosting around text and crosshairs.
dlss_fg.tooltip.provider_status: Read-only provider status. On means the Vulkan proxy-swapchain transport is available; Off means the native provider is not ready.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.mode: Enables hybrid ray-traced block shadows or shadows plus reflections while keeping the normal raster renderer active. Requires Vulkan acceleration structures and ray queries.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.quality: Selects a coordinated ray-tracing quality preset. Higher levels increase scene detail and GPU cost.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.distance: Maximum block radius included in the ray-traced scene. Longer distances increase geometry updates, VRAM use and tracing cost.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.samples: Rays traced per pixel. More samples reduce noise but increase GPU workload substantially.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.stable_sampling: Stabilizes the hybrid ray-query result across frames to reduce noise and flicker. It can make rapid lighting changes converge more slowly.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.runtime_status: Read-only state of the live ray-tracing runtime. A failure points to latest.log for the Vulkan error.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.ray_reconstruction: Uses NVIDIA DLSS Ray Reconstruction with HDR and material guides. Requires supported NVIDIA hardware and an active DLSS quality mode.
dlss_fg.tooltip.rt.pipeline_status: Read-only driver capability. The RT pipeline extension is reported separately from ray-query support.
